note: An invented registry snapshot in the shape of ADP.config.all(): the core groups plus a board group, and an editor. Dates are UTC.

locked.label: Pause editing
locked.help: Freezes every control marked data-adp-edit and shows a banner.

until.label: Paused until
until.help: Shown in the banner; nothing lifts the freeze by itself.

require-hold.label: Require a hold
require-hold.help: A publish touching a part nobody holds is refused by adp.py record.

locked.label: Locked parts
locked.help: Part-id prefixes that are frozen, one per line.

enabled.label: Comment mode
enabled.help: Old threads still resolve when this is off.

changes.label: What changed panel
changes.help: Who sees the list of changes.

theme.label: Theme id
theme.help: The kit's token css reacts to it.

catalog.label: Catalog
catalog.help: The artifact names its own catalog. An https:// address or empty.

read-only.label: Board is read-only
read-only.help: Cards can be opened but not moved or edited.
